content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Spartanburg

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP® credential. Review PMI's official eligibility guidelines to confirm your background qualifies. Contact Granite PM Academy if you need clarification on whether your experience aligns with PMI standards.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our course delivers the required formal education in an accelerated format, combining real-world project scenarios with PMI's framework. Attend all sessions to earn your certificate of completion, required for your PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the boot camp, apply directly to PMI with your course completion certificate and relevant project-management documentation. Pay PMI's exam application fee through their official portal. Allow time for PMI to review and approve your application before scheduling your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions, study guides, and instructor support, to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your exam at a testing center near Spartanburg. On exam day, apply the strategies and content you mastered during the boot camp.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP®, commit to the standard three-year renewal cycle by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continuing education, conference attendance, and project-management activities. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing professional-development resources to help you stay current and maintain your credential.
